text: Depression is characterized by pathological lateral habenula (LHb) hyperactivity within the anti-reward circuitry. However, a unified framework explaining how exercise modulates this specific circuit remains to be established.Aims: To examine whether neurobiological evidence supports the Network-Mediated Habenular Attenuation (NMHA) Model, which proposes exercise as a systemic regulator of LHb pathology.
source_label: Exercise-induced attenuation of the lateral habenula: a multi-axial quantitative synthesis of circuit-level resilience in depression
